message.content:
I'm selling 1 house on Boardwalk to start paying the $625 rent. I'm $498 short, and selling all 5 houses on Park Place and Boardwalk at $100 each would cover it. Right now only Boardwalk can be sold because houses have to come off evenly, so the game will ask again after each sale.

Once rent is paid I'd have $2 and both properties unbuilt. I could then mortgage them for another $375 if I need cash. That's a weak position, but staying in gives me a chance if p1 and p4 bankrupt each other, so it's better than declaring bankruptcy.
message.reasoning:
I'm short $498 against my $625 debt with only $127 on hand. Selling all 5 houses (3 on Boardwalk, 2 on Park Place) at half price gets me $500, enough to cover the debt with $127+$500=$627, and I could also mortgage the properties afterward if needed.

Right now the even-build rule only lets me sell from Boardwalk since it has more houses than Park Place, so I'll sell one house there first and let the engine prompt me again.
